target: EPC footprint and symbol libraries (Altium and KiCad) for KiCad groundwork (G5)
terms: Vendor copyright notices apply; no redistribution permission established. Kept in git-ignored vendor/epc/altium. Linked publicly from the EPC2302 datasheet (p. 13); a public download is not an EPC inquiry.

files.name: EPC Altium Library.zip
files.revision: EPC_2026_Q3b (files dated 2026-08-01): SCHLIB, PcbLib, IntLib, component CSV, report
files.status: downloaded; the server answered 403 without a browser referrer and served the file with the EPC2302 product page as referrer
files.contents_note: the CSV maps EPC2302 to Altium footprint D0606F_100V and names KiCad entries EPC_FETs:D0606F_100V and EPC_FETs:EPC2302; the KiCad library is a separate download (second entry)

files.name: EPC-KiCad-Library.zip
files.revision: EPC_2024Q4a (footprints dated 2024-08-17, KiCad format version 20221018): KiFootprints (47), KiSymbols/EPC_FETs.kicad_sym, Ki3DModels (STEP), cross-reference xlsx
files.source_of_url: EPC guide 'How to Install EPC's KiCad Libraries' (https://epc-co.com/epc/Portals/0/epc/documents/guides/How-to-Install-EPC-KiCad-Library.pdf)
files.status: downloaded (served with the EPC2302 product page as referrer); loads and upgrades in KiCad 10.0.6 (kicad-cli fp upgrade: 47 footprints); EPC2302 footprint D0606F_100V renders
files.note: older than the Altium library (2026 Q3b); D0606F_100V: 7 pads at 0.85 mm pitch, pinout 1 G, 2/4/6 S, 3/5/7 D as in the datasheet; mask and paste are custom polygons (pad margins suppressed). Not yet compared geometrically with the EPC90133/EPC9165 land patterns.
